description: §6.13.5 (S479) negative twin of engine-timed-held-write-unreachable-pos: `@doc = .Published` on a `debounced=` engine names a variant reachable from `.Draft` (Draft -> Review -> Published), so the static check does not fire; whether the commit is legal is judged at commit, against the variant held then.
rationale: §6.13.5: the static check fires only when "no variant reachable from the cell's initial variant along its `rule=` edges is `.Variant` or has `.Variant` in its `rule=`"; `.Review` (reachable) has `.Published` in its `rule=`. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 8.
